index.title: Design Productivity Assistant
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Design Engineer. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Design Productivity Assistant. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help, not a different
index.what_happened_excerpt: This job is a public pattern for using a design productivity assistant to turn ideas and feedback into interactive, deployable design artifacts, while integrating with a version control platform like GitHub.
